task: Project list filtering and persistent selection

requirements.description: A visible Status label and All/Active/Archived/Paused selector above the list call the existing API and display matching rows and count; selected reference structure and DESIGN tokens apply.
Selecting a project updates its panel; hidden selection survives filtering and regains selected appearance; empty successful results have a distinct visible state.

Errors use existing showProblem and Retry; retry uses current filter and keeps selection; loading is separate and only latest response renders. Do not claim browser verification without opening actual app.

checks.description: Node tests execute actual app handlers with an explicitly simulated DOM: status requests/counts, selection persistence, empty/loading/error/retry and latest-response behavior.
Start provided server at PORT=0 and use printed URL to verify all four API statuses, failure/recovery and served implementation entrypoints.
Open actual implementation; exercise filter, selection, empty/error/retry, keyboard focus and wide/narrow layout. Browser is unavailable in this task.
Inspect current source against selected structure, existing UI helpers, blue system tokens and responsive rules; record source trace without claiming visual verification.
